Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying procedures for assumptions of water-sewer districts by cities or towns.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assumptions of watersewer districts by citiesand towns; adding a new section to chapter 36.93 RCW; and adding newsections to chapter 35.13A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.93 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For a proposal by a city to assume less than all of the area of awatersewer district under chapter 35.13A RCW: (1) In addition to the factors of RCW 36.93.170, the board shallconsider the following factors and the effect of the proposal on thefollowing factors: (a) Rates and charges for the city and district systems; (b) Operation and maintenance of the city and district systems; (c) Staffing levels and employees of the city and district; (d) Condition, age, and type of system facilities in the city anddistrict; (e) Water supply rights and contracts and sewer service contractsof the city and district; and p. 1 SB 5069 (f) Financing of capital improvements to the city and districtsystems. (2) In accordance with the first paragraph of RCW 35.13A.050, theboard shall identify the relevant facilities and determine as part ofits decision the economically useful life, sufficient availablecapacity, and reasonable rates for the facilities. (3) The board shall determine as part of its decision a division ofassets and liabilities between the city and district. (4) The board shall hire a consultant or consultants to prepare areport on the factors, identifications, and determinations ofsubsections (1), (2), and (3) of this section. The consultants shallconsider any information or reports prepared by the city and districtregarding the proposal. The cost of the consultant's report shall beborne by the city.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.13A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: When a city assumes less than all of the territory of a watersewerdistrict under this chapter, the city shall install and maintain, atits cost and expense, a water consumption meter on every line providingwater between the district and the city. Each meter shall be locatedat the boundary between the city and district or as close thereto asphysically possible, or as agreed to by the city and district.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.13A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a city desires to impose a utility business and occupation taxon water delivered to or sewer service provided in territory assumedunder this chapter, it shall pass an ordinance specifically imposingthe tax on the delivery or service, even if it has passed a generalordinance imposing the tax. The ordinance shall be deemed to imposethe tax for the first time in the assumed territory for purposes of RCW35.21.706, and shall be subject to referendum in accordance with RCW35.21.706. The ordinance shall be effective before the filing of anotice of intention in counties with a boundary review board, or beforethe passage of the ordinance assuming the territory in counties withouta boundary review board.

If any provision of this act or itsapplication to any person or circumstance is held invalid, theremainder of the act or the application of the provision to otherpersons or circumstances is not affected.
